label: Figure 10.2: Short-run AFC, AVC, ATC and MC curves
alt: Short-run cost curves: AFC falls throughout; AVC, ATC and MC are U-shaped, with MC cutting AVC at its minimum (6 units, $24) and ATC at its minimum (7 units, $39).
caption: AFC (= TFC/q, with TFC = $98) falls continuously. AVC, ATC and MC are U-shaped. MC has the lowest minimum (at 4 units) and cuts AVC exactly at the bottom of AVC (6 units, $24) and ATC exactly at the bottom of ATC (7 units, $39). ATC lies above AVC by the amount of AFC, so the gap narrows as output rises.
